backtest.disclaimer: HEM+ predicts next-year offensive rate (wOBA) out of sample. Volume (PA), baserunning (SB), and the slash line are shown as context because HEM+ is offensive-rate skill, not counting or speed value.

multiyear.note: 3-year HEM+ is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from hem_plus_multiyear_eval.json, not recomputed by this run. It is as of generated_at, NOT as of this board's as_of date, and hitters who joined the pool after that date have no value.

wrc_plus.note: wRC+ is MLB's PUBLISHED value, read verbatim from the bulk season-total sabermetrics feed and joined by MLBAM id. This site DISPLAYS wRC+ rather than deriving it; HEM+ is the offense-rate index it does compute. The value is a season total, never a single stint, so a traded hitter reads one line. Shown only at 100+ PA: it is unshrunk, unlike HEM+, so a thin sample reads as a wild number rather than as league average.

war_rate.note: 100 + 10z of bWAR per PA over hitters with 50+ PA. Ten points is one standard deviation of that pool, not one percent: this is not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio scale. No shrink and no clamp. Rows under 100 PA carry no value.
war_rate.adj_note: war_pa_plus_adj regresses the rate toward the pool rate by sample size (K = pool median PA = 259) and re-standardises on the SHRUNK pool. It is a readability aid for thin samples, not a forward claim: the ship gate G2 failed on every pool, and the post-hoc volume control shows the shrink gain is mostly a volume leak. It does NOT reproduce war/pa on the row.

multiyear_war_rate.note: The 3-year column is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from war_rate_plus_multiyear_eval.json, not recomputed by this run. It is as of generated_at, NOT as of this board's as_of date, and hitters who joined the pool after that date have no value.

keys.split: teams[].orders.vr / teams[].orders.vl - the hand-labelled orders. Trust the LABELS only when bat_side.available is true.
keys.neutral: teams[].order_no_platoon - present ONLY when the split was not applied. The one constructed nine, under a name that claims nothing about handedness.
keys.flag: teams[].platoon_applied - false means render ONE lineup and say the split is unavailable; do not offer a vs-LHP / vs-RHP toggle.

bat_side.note: Bat side (L/R/S) drives the vs-LHP / vs-RHP order: the platoon term and the handedness stagger both read it.

team_basis.label: hitting 2026
team_basis.note: current_roster points `team` at the club MLB's transaction feed says employs the player today, for the charts AND the aggregates, so an August acquisition credits his whole season to his new club. stats_earned keeps the club the stats were earned with. n_team_unresolved counts rows serving a blank team; those rows are absent from every team rollup.
